```plato
    //==
    // # Reading a solution
    //
    // The per-element and per-node arrays a result view consumes, and the
    // deformed geometry it draws.

    // The von Mises stress in every cell of a solved solid model, in cell order.
    VonMisesStresses(model: ElasticModel3D, solution: ElasticSolution3D): Array<Pressure>
    {
        var moduli = model.Material.ToLameParameters;
        return model.Mesh.Cells.Map(c =>
            c.ElementStrain(model.Mesh.Positions, solution.Displacements)
                .ToStressState(moduli).VonMisesStress);
    }
```

```plato
    // The von Mises stress in every face of a solved plane model, in face order.
    VonMisesStresses(model: ElasticModel2D, solution: ElasticSolution2D): Array<Pressure>
        => model.Mesh.Faces.Map(f =>
            f.ElementStress(model, solution.Displacements).VonMisesStress);
```
